title: L'Entropiste indulges in olfactory decadence with Festin
summary: The young perfume house L'Entropiste unveils Festin, a new fragrance created by Bertrand Duchaufour. Built around notes of blackberry, caviar, truffle, shagreen leather, and oud, the composition continues the house's exploration of opulent, uncompromising perfumery, where order emerges from chaos. Inspired by a decadent banquet in Nero's palace as Rome burned, Festin plays on the contrasts between sensuality, and smoke. The fragrance opens with blackberry, violet leaf, and a truffle...
